name: AI-Powered SEO Suggestions
author: Rustaurius

sections.description:
Boost on-page SEO with real-time, AI-powered suggestions—right in the editor.

🌟 Pro | ℹ️ Support

AI-Powered SEO Suggestions analyzes your content (title, meta description, headings, body, links, and images) and surfaces clear, focused actions to improve discoverability and clicks. It also provides AI Semantic Keyword Hints to expand topical coverage and AI Fix-It Tips to turn scores into next steps.

Designed to complement existing SEO plugins (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO), not replace them. Keep using your preferred SEO plugin for sitemaps and schema; this plugin focuses on on-page optimization and editorial guidance.

🔥 Features (Free / Lite)

  • ✅ AI Semantic Keyword Hints (up to 2 terms) to broaden topical relevance
  • ✅ AI Fix-It Tips (up to 3 suggestions) based on your current content signals
  • ✅ Analyzer for titles, meta, headings (H1–H3), readability, links, and images
  • ✅ Gutenberg sidebar panel and Classic Editor metabox
  • ✅ Compatibility with Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, and All in One SEO (read/write safe)
  • ✅ Dashboard overview with recent analyses
  • ✅ Role visibility control (show panel to specific roles)
  • ✅ Only analyze when a target keyword is set (optional toggle)
  • ✅ REST endpoints for scores and AI suggestions (read-only)

🌟 Pro Features (Upgrade)

  • 🧠 AI Meta Generation: titles and descriptions with tone/style controls
  • 🔎 Expanded Semantic Keywords: 10–20+ terms, clustering, “where to use” tips
  • 🧩 Schema Assistant: Article, Product, FAQ, and HowTo helpers
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Optimizations: product-specific tips and fields
  • 📊 Reports & History: trends, exports, and REST endpoints for automation
  • 🧰 Bulk tools: batch analysis, quick fixes, CSV exports

Learn more about the pro version here

💡 Why Use This Plugin?

  • Clarity: No vague scores—get concrete actions (e.g., “Add primary keyword in first H2,” “Tighten meta to ~150 chars”).
  • Coverage: AI suggests related terms/entities to improve topical depth.
  • Compatibility: Works with your current SEO plugin setup.
  • Low friction: Built for editors; fast, cached results; minimal configuration.

External Services

This plugin uses the OpenAI API to generate AI keyword hints and fix-it tips.
The request can include the post title, headings, target keywords, and normalized analyzer signals.

OpenAI policies:
– Terms of service: https://openai.com/policies/row-terms-of-use/
– Privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/row-privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ai-powered-seo-suggestions or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins.
  3. Go to AI-Powered SEO → Settings and enter your OpenAI API key.
  4. Open any post to view the AI-Powered SEO panel in the editor.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. Add your API key in AI-Powered SEO → Settings. You can select a model and set a request timeout.

Will this overwrite my Yoast/Rank Math/SEOPress/AIOSEO fields?

No. The Lite version provides AI suggestions and optional manual fields. It does not overwrite existing plugin meta unless you explicitly save values into those fields.

Is there a free AI feature?

Yes. Lite includes AI Semantic Keyword Hints (up to 2 terms) and AI Fix-It Tips (up to 3 tips). Pro expands these with more terms, variants, bulk tools, and deeper guidance.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Lite analysis works on product content; advanced product-specific tips and schema helpers are in Pro.

Will this slow down my site?

Results are cached per post. There’s also a setting to run analysis only when a target keyword is set. AI requests are short and use a small, fast model by default.

Is this a replacement for Yoast or Rank Math?

No. Keep your existing SEO plugin for sitemaps, schema, and global SEO. This plugin complements them with AI-driven on-page suggestions and editor guidance.

Is the plugin GDPR friendly?

Content sent to OpenAI is limited to what’s necessary (title, headings, target keywords, analyzer summaries). Review OpenAI’s policies for data retention. You can disable AI features anytime.
